```python
def shares(run):
    """The share of the people taking each mode, in percent."""
    modes = run.trip_modes().to_pandas()
    return (modes.groupby("mode")["weight"].sum() / modes["weight"].sum() * 100).round(2)


before = base.run("delft-base")
calls = before.transit_calls().to_pandas()
busiest = calls.groupby("line")["boardings"].sum().idxmax()  # the line with the most boardings
print("busiest line:", busiest)
shares(before)
```
